verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.crewai.com/llms.txt and per-page Markdown docs that point agents back to the llms.txt index, and versioned _llms pages exist. The installation docs also offer a ready-to-paste setup prompt for Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor that installs official CrewAI skills and points the agent at the right docs. Missing for 10: no evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt, and no independent community corroboration of agents actually using these docs.
